newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai cabinet okays state firm pipeline projects.
newsitem.headline: Thai cabinet okays state firm pipeline projects.

text.p: The Thai government on Tuesday approved a total of 78.05 billion baht ($312 million) worth of pipeline projects from the state-run Petroleum Authority of Thailand to be built between 1997-2005, an official said.
The 12 natural gas pipeline projects were part of Thailand's pipeline master plan.
The projects included major pipelines from the Thai-Malaysian Joint Development Area and a number of fields in the Gulf of Thailand such as Pailin and Erawan.

Thailand's 8th National Economic and Social Development Plan (1997-2001) aims at sustaining imported energy at a level of not more than 70 percent and of promoting the procurement of local energy resources.
At present, 95 percent of indigenous natural gas procurement is from the Gulf of Thailand, with Unocal Thailand as main procurer.
